body:
@imshinto Thanks for opening this issue.

Right now this is not easily solvable. This would require a new option value in limit= so that we understand we should not send any limit parameter.

For this to work for now you will have to control the limit parameter from the frontend. Indeed it means you won't be able to use the dashboard to control the number of facet values being displayed. The widget was never designed with this usecase in mind, for now.

But as we are revamping instantsearch.js, this is a good indicator that we should be able to do what you want.
